title: Habit Tracker and Routine Builder App

prd.oneLiner: Connect habit setup, daily check-ins, streaks, reminders, reflection, and pattern insights so routines are visible and actionable.
prd.goal: Help people increase weekly completion and consistent streaks for the habits that matter to them.
prd.whyNow: When people start a habit, check-ins, reminders, setbacks, and weekly reflection are disconnected, making consistency difficult to sustain.
prd.problem: When people start a habit, check-ins, reminders, setbacks, and weekly reflection are disconnected, making consistency difficult to sustain.
prd.solution: Connect habit setup, daily check-ins, streaks, reminders, reflection, and pattern insights so routines are visible and actionable.
prd.alternatives: Notes, spreadsheets, general-purpose apps, and single-purpose trackers
prd.differentiator: Connect personal goals, records, and progress so the next action is clear.

targets.name: Individual building and maintaining daily habits and routines
targets.needs: Quickly register needed work and know its status.
targets.pain: When people start a habit, check-ins, reminders, setbacks, and weekly reflection are disconnected, making consistency difficult to sustain.

targets.name: App operator managing habit templates and reminders
targets.needs: Manage priority and history and review operations metrics.
targets.pain: When people start a habit, check-ins, reminders, setbacks, and weekly reflection are disconnected, making consistency difficult to sustain.

targets.name: System and policy administrator
targets.needs: Manage access, policy, and audit history.
targets.pain: When people start a habit, check-ins, reminders, setbacks, and weekly reflection are disconnected, making consistency difficult to sustain.

scenarios.text: An operational user registers required work and checks its status.
An operator processes queued work and handles exceptions.
System and policy administrator reviews policy and access.
System and policy administrator reviews audit records and operating metrics.

prd.northStar: Share of active users completing their planned weekly action

kpis.name: On-time processing rate
kpis.target: Help people increase weekly completion and consistent streaks for the habits that matter to them.
kpis.method: Monthly aggregation of state changes against target dates

kpis.name: Operations visibility
kpis.method: Share of records connected to reporting

inScope: Habit, target frequency, reminder time, and start-date entry
Today's check-in, streak, weekly pattern, and goal-completion lookup
Habit completion, skip logging, reminder adjustment, and weekly reflection handling
Streak, completion rate, time-of-day, and habit-trend reporting
Habit, target frequency, reminder time, and start-date entry validation and duplicate prevention
nonGoals: Operating regulated financial, health, or employment services
Sharing personal data without explicit user consent
assumptions: Users manage their own profile and record data.
Notifications and optional data connections require explicit consent.
risks: Incomplete personal records can weaken progress insights.
Exposure of sensitive personal data can reduce trust and retention.
openQuestions: What first-week action makes the value clear to a new user?
Which reminders and data connections must remain opt-in?
constraints: Users must be able to export and delete their records.
Sensitive data follows data minimization and explicit consent.
Permission, policy, and state changes require audit logs.
